title: Have Space Suit—Will Travel
author: Robert A. Heinlein
summary: Teenager Kip Russell wins a used spacesuit in a soap contest and is abducted along with a young girl nicknamed Peewee. He ends up travelling to the Moon and beyond. This is one of Heinlein's novels for younger readers.
readIf: you like classic, optimistic space adventure with a resourceful teenage hero.
skipIf: you want modern characters and attitudes, since the book is clearly of the 1950s.
